headline: Man killed in home invasion shooting near Casa Loma
briefing: Top stories right now: Man killed in home invasion shooting near Casa Loma; Cyclist dead after being struck, pinned under school bus in downtown Toronto; and Ontario to open HOV lanes to solo drivers on Jan. 1, during non-peak hours.

keyDates.label: Senate Democrats vote; Stelco recall
keyDates.why: Democratic senators choose between Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen for majority leader by secret ballot, and 175 laid-off Stelco workers are due back in Hamilton.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
keyDates.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.

keyDates.label: U.S. government funding deadline
keyDates.why: Federal funding runs out unless the outgoing Congress passes a spending bill or a temporary extension, which is also the likeliest vehicle for any new air traffic control money.

stories.headline: Cyclist dead after being struck, pinned under school bus in downtown Toronto
stories.summary: A man has died after being struck by a school bus in downtown Toronto on Wednesday morning. Emergency crews responded to the intersection of University Avenue and Dundas Street around 9:30 a.m. for a collision between a mini school bus and a cyclist.

stories.headline: Ontario to open HOV lanes to solo drivers on Jan. 1, during non-peak hours
stories.summary: Starting in 2027, single-occupant vehicles will be allowed to use Ontario’s high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) lanes during off-peak hours, the Ministry of Transportation announced on Wednesday. In a release, the Ministry said the move would “improve traffic flow and get drivers to their destinations faster.”
